author: Septarap
quote:
No. Nope. This isn't the same GTA I eagerly waited for, for 10 years 7 months after playing GTA V. This is an awesome game, don't get me wrong, it is just not named appropriately. 
GTA isn't just about open-world and driving. It is about the freedom you experience to escape reality. If I am gonna have to be cordial to people driving cars and not be able to "commandeer" vehicle from just anyone, be careful about not go around and date anyone like CJ could in San Andreas, then this is not GTA.
Not to mention, I BOUGHT A "PS5 PRO" for this "Life-Sim" game. Sony has scammed me. 
And Rockstar KNEW people would hate the game and would WANT to return it. That's why it is just a code-in-a-box.

author: Septarap
quote:
My first time playing Ocarina of time. I have played and finished BOTW before, so that was my reference point for Zelda games. 
.
The presentation itself consumed me alive! No game has looked this good on my Switch or SOUNDED this good either. 
.
While the combat in here is too simplistic and doesn't have much variety. The bosses were literally a pushover barring a few. But the more I played, the more I realized that this game is less about fighting and MORE about exploring and puzzle solving. And this being my first experience, the puzzles were genuinely brilliant and hard to crack at times. 
.
The one thing among others that kept me glued to my Switch 2 was the narrative. The reviews say the story is the most faithful to the N64 version, and if that's the case, it stood the test of time.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Septarap
quote:
I love the IP. And this is why I hated this game. 
The graphics and story may be great, but the gameplay (which also had the bones of being amazing) let it down.
The core reason, i believe, is because by nature Wolverine cannot die, he regenerates. Portraying him dying in any sequence would be lore-wise incorrect. And THAT is why, the game provides all the tricks they can think of for saving Wolverine and advancing story, even at the risk of cheating.

quote: True, it's not perfect. True, it's full of bugs. But this is at least the same old GTA as I know and love. It has problems, but I managed to play through Vice City and San Andreas with minimum bugs, none of which were game breaking.
